/*selectMasterMpIfOrderStatusPopList*/
SELECT A.BUYER_ITEM_NO /* 구매사 품목코드 */ , REPLACE(REPLACE(A.DESCRIPTION, '\"', '＂'), '''', '‘') AS DESCRIPTION /* 품목명 */ , REPLACE(REPLACE(A.SPECIFICATION, '\"', '＂'), '''', '‘') AS SPECIFICATION /* 규격 */ , A.AGENT /* 공급사코드 */ , (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = A.AGENT) as AGENT_NAME /* 공급사명 */ , A.UNIT_MEASURE /* 단위 */ , A.TARGET_PRICE /* 제시단가 */ , A.CONTRACT_NO /* 계약서번호 */ , A.CONTRACT_SEQ /* 계약서순번 */ , DECODE(A.PROCESS_TYPE,'0','직납','1','재고','2','T/R','3','VMI','') AS PROCESS_TYPE /* 제품조달방법(유형) */ , NVL((SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = A.ORIGIN_AGENT),' ') AS ORIGIN_AGENT /* 물류센터관련 공급사(실공급사) */ ,(SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = A.BELOW_COMORG_CODE) AS BELOW_COMORG_NAME /* 적용구매사 */ FROM ICOMCQDT A /* 구매사별 계약서 가격정보 */ , ICOMBYIT B /* 구매사카탈로그 상품정보 */ WHERE ( A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = B.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND B.BUYER = #{st_byca_comorg_code} AND B.BUYER_ITEM_NO = #{st_buyer_item_no} AND A.STATUS <> 'D' AND A.BELOW_COMORG_CODE = #{st_buyer} ) ORDER BY AGENT_NAME
